+def test_statement_limit_has_a_maximum(bank, at):
+    conn = ledger.open_db(bank["path"])
+    ledger.deposit(conn, bank["eur"].id, Money.of("1.00", "EUR"), at=at("2026-05-02"))
+    ledger.deposit(conn, bank["eur"].id, Money.of("2.00", "EUR"), at=at("2026-05-03"))
+    conn.close()
+    client = login(bank["app"], bank["owner"])
+    url = f"/api/accounts/{bank['eur'].id}/statement?from=2026-05-01&to=2026-05-31"
+    assert client.get(url + "&limit=501").status_code == 422
+    assert client.get(url + "&limit=500").status_code == 200
+    response = client.get(url + "&limit=2")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert len(response.json()["lines"]) == 2
+
